# GroupDocs.Assembly.Mcp.Tests

Integration tests and deployment how-to guides for GroupDocs.Assembly.Mcp — the MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, VS Code / GitHub Copilot, and other MCP clients) generate Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and e-mail documents from templates and data, locally, with GroupDocs.Assembly for .NET.

This repo validates the published artifact end-to-end (NuGet via dnx, or the Docker image) and doubles as a reference for using it from every supported channel.

## Primary repository

- MCP server source + package: https://github.com/groupdocs-assembly/GroupDocs.Assembly.Mcp
- NuGet package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/GroupDocs.Assembly.Mcp
- Docker images: ghcr.io/groupdocs-assembly/assembly-net-mcp and docker.io/groupdocs/assembly-net-mcp

## Deployment channels covered by how-to guides

- how-to/01-install-from-nuget.md — dnx (recommended) + global dotnet tool
- how-to/02-run-via-docker.md — container image + docker-compose, --user on Linux
- how-to/03-verify-mcp-registry.md — MCP registry discovery and NuGet.org auto-generated mcp.json
- how-to/04-use-with-claude-desktop.md — Claude Desktop stdio config
- how-to/05-use-with-vscode-copilot.md — VS Code / GitHub Copilot config
- how-to/06-run-integration-tests.md — run this repo's test suite locally and in CI
- how-to/07-use-with-cursor.md — Cursor config

## MCP tools exposed by the server

- assemble_document — fill a template with data (inline JSON, or a JSON/XML/CSV file or a document table) and save the result in its own format, another format of its family, or PDF
- assemble_per_record — one document per element of a JSON array (mail merge); failed records are listed
- get_template_fields — a template's tags, data names, fields and a JSON skeleton of the data to fill in
- get_document_info — a file as a template (family, tags, save targets) and as data (keys, columns, tables)
- get_supported_formats — template formats, save targets per family, data formats
- get_license_status — licensing mode, metered consumption and engine version (from GroupDocs.Mcp.Core)

## Example prompts for AI agents

- Fill invoice-template.docx with this order and save it as a PDF: …
- What data does contract-template.docx need? Give me a JSON skeleton.
- Generate a welcome letter for every customer in customers.json, named after the customer.
- Build the report from contracts-table.xlsx and Contracts.xlsx.
- Which formats can GroupDocs.Assembly fill and save?

## Environment variables

- GROUPDOCS_MCP_STORAGE_PATH — base folder for templates, data and generated documents (defaults to the current working directory)
- GROUPDOCS_MCP_OUTPUT_PATH — optional, routes generated documents to a separate folder
- GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH — path to a GroupDocs licence file; omit for evaluation mode
- GROUPDOCS_METERED_PUBLIC_KEY / GROUPDOCS_METERED_PRIVATE_KEY — metered (pay-per-use) licensing; the private key is a secret

## Test-suite switches

- MCP_PACKAGE_VERSION — published version to test (default from Directory.Build.props)
- MCP_SERVER_DLL — test a locally built server DLL instead of the package
- MCP_SERVER_IMAGE — test a container image instead of the package

## Key facts for AI agents

- Tests the shipped artifact, not the source. No project reference to the server.
- Wire names are snake_case (assemble_document, get_template_fields, …).
- Failures set isError and start with the tool's prefix, e.g. "Document assembly failed for '<file>': …".
- Generated documents are read back and checked for values from the data.
- The suite passes without a licence. Metered tests are a separate, deliberately triggered workflow.
- Requires the .NET 10 SDK (dnx). Linux needs libgdiplus for presentation templates and fonts for PDF/XPS output.
